head_commit.message:
[chore][lint]: inline format args to satisfy clippy uninlined-format-args

Context:
* Clippy is run with -D clippy::uninlined-format-args in CI.
* codex-tui test and codex-windows-sandbox had several format-like macro uses with separate args.

Change:
* Inline format arguments in:
  - tui/src/bottom_pane/chat_composer.rs (test assertion message).
  - windows-sandbox-rs: acl.rs, audit.rs, cap.rs, env.rs, logging.rs, token.rs, winutil.rs, lib.rs, process.rs.

Risk:
* Low; message formatting only. No functional logic changed.

Tests:
* cargo test -p codex-tui passes locally.
* cargo clippy -p codex-tui --tests -- -D clippy::uninlined-format-args clean.
* cargo clippy -p codex-windows-sandbox --tests -- -D clippy::uninlined-format-args clean.

Verification:
* Ran cargo fmt across workspace.

head_commit.message:
[test][app-server]: stabilize user-agent test by removing env override

Context:
* CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE was set in the parent shell (codex_vscode).
* App-server tests inherited it, causing the UA to start with codex_vscode/... instead of the default codex_cli_rs/....

Change:
* In ^Gpp-server/tests/suite/user_agent.rs, construct the child with McpProcess::new_with_env and remove the override env var for the child.
* Add comment explaining why.

Risk:
* Low; change is test-only and does not affect production code paths.

Tests:
* Ran cargo test -p codex-app-server — 51 passed, 0 failed.

Verification:
* Reproduced the failing test and re-ran it targeted: passed.
* Ran full workspace tests and clippy locally before commit.
